resource_saving_tool_policy_hypothesis.statement: The cheapest robust path is not to embed complete external frameworks. Use mature tools in three bounded roles: (1) test/falsifier donors, (2) read-only witness/observability donors, and (3) architecture comparators. Promote runtime dependencies only when an exact F2 ablation proves they close a blocker materially better than a thin native implementation without creating a second truth, coordination, workflow or effect authority.
support: DoWhy E2 already favors native deterministic placebo/refuter controls over full dependency import for WP507.
Git-ref semaphore E2 uses GitHub's existing ref database instead of adding Redis/etcd/ZooKeeper coordination infrastructure.
Hypothesis and DBOS objectives were atomically claimed by parallel workers during this fusion, demonstrating that duplicate avoidance must remain live and granular.
Current authority explicitly forbids second effect executor/journal and keeps runtime/provider promotion at zero without executable evidence.
resource_saving_tool_policy_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: A full mature framework may reduce total engineering risk more than thin pattern distillation by providing recovery, invariants and operational hardening that native implementations repeatedly re-create incorrectly.
resource_saving_tool_policy_hypothesis.discriminator: For each candidate, compare thin-native vs framework-backed fixture on the same blocker using correctness/falsifier coverage, dependency footprint, cold-start/latency, state-authority count, migration cost and failure-recovery behavior. Full import wins only if it detects/prevents a real class missed by the thin path at acceptable authority and resource cost.
